```lean
theorem lg_target {n a : ℕ} : (∃ x, x ^ n = a) ↔ n = 0 ∧ a = 1 ∨ n ≠ 0 ∧ n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases' h with x hx
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · exact Or.inl (And.intro h0 (Eq.refl 1))
    · have h2 : n.nthRoot a ^ n = a := Nat.nthRoot.pow_eq_a n a
      exact Or.inr (And.intro (Ne.symm h0) h2)
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · exact ⟨1, pow_zero n⟩
    · exact ⟨n.nthRoot a, h2⟩
```
